supplementaryPrimarySources.ownUse: N=n*N_A; the exact entity count for one mole is6.02214076e23. Card008 must distinguish the constant with unit from its numerical value.

supplementaryPrimarySources.title: Royal Society of Chemistry helium entry
supplementaryPrimarySources.ownUse: He has1s2 while occupying the noble-gas main group. This is a concrete counterexample to card004 without exception.

supplementaryPrimarySources.title: IUPAC Gold Book2025 Nernst equation
supplementaryPrimarySources.ownUse: The activity reaction quotient contains stoichiometric powers. Its simple concentration-ratio note is a special case, not a general metal-/proton-coupled halfcell formula.

supplementaryPrimarySources.title: IUPAC Gold Book2025 pH
supplementaryPrimarySources.ownUse: Activity definition underlies the concentration approximation used at school. The missing temperature qualification of card012 is separate from tolerated school concentration shorthand.

supplementaryPrimarySources.title: Arcis/Harvey2025: Ionization Constant of Water
supplementaryPrimarySources.ownUse: The self-ionization equilibrium depends on temperature; neutral pH derives from pK_w/2, not universal7.

supplementaryPrimarySources.title: LMU München: Aminosäuren und Proteine, printed2
supplementaryPrimarySources.ownUse: The conventional Biuret response requires at least two suitable peptide/amide groups, relevant to the Dipeptid counterexample.
